body: Fix live agy 1.5.17 quota probe rejection in lib/pools.mjs where untouched rolling quota buckets (remaining_fraction === 1 / remainingPercent === 100) emit reset_time '1970-01-01T00:00:00Z' (Date.parse === 0). Update parseQuotaProbeOutput (parseWindow) and isValidStatusLinePoolWindow in lib/pools.mjs to permit resetTimeMs === 0 strictly and only when remainingPercent === 100, while continuing to reject resetTimeMs === 0 when remainingPercent < 100 and continuing to reject all other past timestamps (< now - 10s). Add unit tests in test/pools.test.mjs covering 1970-01-01T00:00:00Z with 100% (accepted in both parseQuotaProbeOutput and writeStatusLineQuotaCache) vs <100% (rejected with invalid_quota_timestamp).
title: Accept unstarted 100% quota windows with epoch-zero resetTime in pools.mjs
